Bench vibration in the laboratory is disturbing the settling test and overstating SVI

Polymer carryover from primary treatment is selectively inhibiting nitrifiers in the basin
Primary polymer improved capture so much that nitrifiers starved

evidence.label: Effluent ammonia is 16 mg/L and nitrate is 0.4 mg/L, showing nitrification is the failing step.
Carbon dose increases have raised effluent BOD without producing any nitrate to denitrify.
Basin DO and SRT checks show nitrifiers limited by low DO at peak load.
A trial fixing peak DO lowered ammonia and only then did nitrate appear for denitrification.

inference.prompt: Which explanation is best supported by all of the observations?

options.label: Internal recycle failure is keeping nitrate from the anoxic zone
Carbon dosing cannot fix total nitrogen while nitrification produces almost no nitrate to denitrify
Denitrifiers have died and must be reseeded before anything works
The carbon product is defective and inactive

inference.explanation: There is almost no nitrate anywhere to recycle or denitrify, which contradicts recycle failure as the main fault, and carbon raised BOD, showing it is active. The DO trial producing nitrate first supports nitrification as the limiting step.

Carbon product activity test

clueText.nc-b: Once peak DO was fixed, ammonia fell, nitrate formed, and the existing carbon dose began removing it.
clueText.nc-c: Carbon activity tests show the product is active.

The laboratory lost the samples and blamed the plant

Laboratory receipt log
